name: Mail Server
description: Manage SMTP settings and send automated emails
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Privileged: unscoped reads/writes on users, received_emails and email_attachments via the trusted bridge.
Privileged: read/write SMTP, global email and secret-named options (e.g. DKIM private key).
Required for MX resolution (DNS), direct SMTP delivery (NET) and providing the host-wide send function.
Required to alert users about new inbound emails in real-time and register the email transport.
Required to read email attachments and check paths under uploads/mail-attachments.
Required to save email attachments under uploads/mail-attachments.
